name: Ilorin Emirate
alt: Ilorin Emirate of the Sokoto Caliphate

predecessors.name: Oyo Empire
predecessors.text: Ilorin and the north of Oyo, where the Kakanfo Afonja rebelled with Shehu Alimi

successors.name: Royal Niger Company
successors.text: Ilorin, 'occupied by the Royal Niger Company in 1897'

ledger.x: 1817: Afonja rebels at Ilorin with Shehu Alimi.
1823: Abd al-Salam 'pledged allegiance to the Sokoto Caliphate in 1823'; 'Ilorin became an emirate of the Sokoto Caliphate under the authority of Gwandu'.
1840: Ilorin's southward jihad ends at Oshogbo.
1897: the tie to Sokoto ends when Ilorin 'was occupied by the Royal Niger Company in 1897'.
1897: the Royal Niger Company occupies Ilorin.
1897: Ilorin ceases to be an independent emirate; its lands were 'incorporated into the British Northern Nigeria Protectorate in 1900'.

wars.name: Ilorin-Ibadan wars
wars.outcome: Ibadan stopped Ilorin's southward expansion: 'decisively defeated Ilorin' in 1838 (Emirate page), the jihad 'stopped at Oshogbo in 1840' (Ilorin page).

wars.name: Royal Niger Company occupation of Ilorin
wars.outcome: The Royal Niger Company occupied Ilorin in 1897; the emirate was brought under the Northern Protectorate 'through diplomacy and applying minimal force' (Emirate page, undated).
